differs.mechanic: Grains pour from above in one stream per region and pile up in glass jars under gravity, then fall through the opened jar floors, instead of a dust ring condensing into digits and melting into bars.
differs.layout: Four same-size glass jars on a shared graduated scale fill the left of the stage, with the total, a one-line customer quote and its attribution in a column on the right; the parent has copy on the left and a ring, digits and bars on the right.
differs.data: A count per customer region read as a fill level against tick marks, summed into a total of teams served, instead of one week's events split by source.
differs.moment: The last stream runs dry into the North America jar, its count and the total land together, and the quote stands beside four filled jars.

blurb: Grains of real customers pour into one glass jar per region, and the total of teams served is read off the four fill levels beside a customer's quote.
